viewRules.emptyId: A map or plot has an empty id.
viewRules.sharedId: Two maps or plots have the id "{id}"; an id names one view.
viewRules.plotsWithoutIds: Two plots of the table "{table}" have no id; give each plot an id.
viewRules.plotIdIsDataRef: A plot's id "{id}" is the dataRef of a plot without an id; give each plot an id.
viewRules.linkSource: Link source "{source}" is not the id (or the dataRef) of a plot of this specification.
viewRules.linkTarget: Link target "{target}" is not the id of a map of this specification.
viewRules.linkLayer: Link from "{source}": map "{target}" has no layer "{layer}".
viewRules.linkTable: Link from "{source}": map "{target}" draws no layer of the table "{table}"; name the layer.

renamedKey: This spec uses "{key}"{at}, which autk-grammar 5 renamed to "{renamedTo}".

notRunYet.what: "buildingsZeroHeight" (Curio makes a building without a height 6 m tall when it loads the data, so the key would change nothing)

notRunYetKey: This spec uses {what}{at}, which Curio does not run yet.
osmElementsMixed: "osmElements" on one view of the OpenStreetMap table "{table}" and not on another
osmElementsInPlace: "osmElements" on the OpenStreetMap table "{table}" while compute pass {pass} changes it in place without writeBack

grammarRefuses.afterNotCompute: Data source {at} ({type}): after must be 'compute', the one phase a source runs after, not {value}.
grammarRefuses.afterReadsUnwritten: Data source {at} ({type}) runs after compute and reads "{table}", which compute pass {pass} writes without writeBack, so autk-db holds "{table}" without that pass's result. Set writeBack: true on the pass.
grammarRefuses.heatmapWithoutAggregate: Heatmap "{table}": the groupBy entry for column "{column}" has no aggregateFn to combine the rows near a cell, and a cell holds one value; use sum, avg, count, min, max or weighted.

rasterPass: a compute pass over the raster "{table}"
